title: Evaluatie besluit uitwisseling leer- en begeleidingsgegevens
descriptions: Data was collected for evaluation of a policy regarding data exchange between schools for the Dutch Ministry of Education ( link to policy ). Data are survey answers from representitives of primary, secondary and SEN schools in the Netherlands.
